run_tracking_test: run the MMTrack test script to evaluate a tracking model with a config file and checkpoint
test_tracking_with_detector: test a tracking model using a separate detector checkpoint file for detection
test_tracking_with_reid: test a tracking model using a separate reid checkpoint file for re-identification
run_tracking_with_cfg_options: run tracking evaluation with custom config options to override default settings
run_tracking_with_launcher: run tracking test with a job launcher like pytorch, slurm, or mpi for distributed testing
